build_DDPLoss_wrapper: build a DDP-aware loss wrapper using DDPLoss with mean reduction for distributed training
create_DDPMTLoss_with_reduction: create a DDPMTLoss wrapper with per_structure reduction and a custom coefficient for atom-wise loss
register_MSELoss: register an MSE loss function via the fairchem registry for use with DDPLoss
use_L2NormLoss_for_forces: use L2NormLoss to compute the L2 norm of force prediction errors across atoms
create_PerAtomMAELoss: create a PerAtomMAELoss that divides MAE by atom count for normalized scalar predictions
